fact_flags.fact: The Forest Survey of India assessment found that over 90 per cent of the Aravalli landscape would be excluded under the 100 m threshold, which sparked fears of more mining and construction.
fact_flags.problem: The booklet says the 2025 definition sparks fears over mining and construction (page 5 headline); it does not say the 90% exclusion finding caused those fears. The causal link is an inference.
